review.repair: Trim first 3 seconds and freeze tail; use brief single-vowel reaction on observed mouth opening, exact spoken subtitle, retime action captions and splash effects.
review.limitations: Brief reaction timing is visually appropriate; full phoneme lip synchronization and subjective audio listening are not verified. This published trial predates the restored 11-second requirement and is not a template for future duration.
review.publication: Facebook accepted the exact reviewed file after Page token renewal.
